display.purpose: Hero headline only. One per page.

label.purpose: Terminal-style uppercase tags, table column headers, status prefixes.

shadows.name: glass-float
shadows.purpose: Form wrapper and result card ambient halo.

shadows.name: glass-float-sm
shadows.purpose: Smaller floating panels and inline glass elements.

shadows.name: amber-success-glow
shadows.purpose: Result card post-success only. Never used on other cards.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions (color, opacity, border).

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: Scale-up entrances. Used sparingly on result card.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Input row stacks → row; main responsive pivot.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Dashboard table: some columns hide below lg.

components.name: Primary Button (Amber)
components.description: The main CTA. Shorten URL on home, Refresh on dashboard. Amber fill, near-black text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #f59e0b; color: #0c0c0d; padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: 14px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #d97706; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f59e0b; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary actions: Copy, QR, deactivate-adjacent actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); color: #d4d4d8; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.10); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.20); color: #fafafa; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.28); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ghost.ds-btn-ghost--copied { color: #f59e0b; border-color: rgba(245,158,11,0.30); background: rgba(245,158,11,0.08); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: URL input, alias input, API key input. Dark fill, subtle border, brightens on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; background: rgba(9,9,11,0.60); color: #fafafa; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #71717a; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.28); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,0.08); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Card / Container
components.description: Glass panels for the form wrapper and result card.
components.css: .ds-card { background: rgba(24,24,27,0.80); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10); border-radius: 18px; padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 0 40px -12px rgba(255,255,255,0.12); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); } .ds-card--success { box-shadow: 0 0 32px -8px rgba(245,158,11,0.18), 0 0 40px -12px rgba(255,255,255,0.08); } .ds-label { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #71717a; margin-bottom: 12px; }

components.name: Short URL Display
components.description: The result short link: monospace, truncated, dotted underline, amber on hover.
components.css: .ds-shorturl { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'Cascadia Code', Menlo, monospace; font-size: 14px; color: #fafafa; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-style: dotted; text-underline-offset: 3px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; display: block; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10); background: rgba(9,9,11,0.60); transition: color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-shorturl:hover { color: #f59e0b; border-color: rgba(245,158,11,0.30); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Active / Inactive state indicator in the dashboard table.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-badge--active { background: rgba(52,211,153,0.10); color: #34d399; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(52,211,153,0.20); } .ds-badge--inactive { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); color: #71717a; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.10); }

components.name: Header Navigation
components.description: Sticky top header with blur backdrop, logo left, nav right.
components.css: .ds-header { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 50; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 16px 24px; background: rgba(9,9,11,0.70); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); } .ds-logo { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: #fafafa; text-decoration: none; letter-spacing: -0.025em; transition: opacity 150ms ease; } .ds-logo:hover { opacity: 0.75; } .ds-nav-link { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #a1a1aa; text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #fafafa; }

narrative.overview:
URLy operates like a well-engineered command-line tool translated into a visual interface. Every element is placed with intent; nothing decorates without earning its position. The zinc-950 background recedes like a dark terminal canvas, and warm amber — precise, rare, earned — marks the moments that matter: the action you take, the success you receive.

The palette is predominantly monochromatic. Zinc provides the depth hierarchy: five values from base to elevated, each doing a distinct spatial job. Amber appears only where the user's action or result is confirmed — the primary CTA and copy-confirmed state — which makes it feel like a signal rather than a style choice.

Typography is controlled but not cold. Inter is used at extremes of weight: 800 for the hero that communicates the product in one line, 400 for the body that gets out of the way, monospace for slugs and URLs where precision matters.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black zinc base with five-step tonal depth hierarchy
Single warm amber accent, used for primary CTA and confirmed success only
Monospace typography for all URL, slug, and code content
Tactile interactions: scale and color transitions on press
Dot-grid background texture at low opacity — implies structure without noise

rules.name: The Amber Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Amber is the only warm color in the system. It appears on ≤2 interactive elements per screen at any time. Using it elsewhere — text, borders, backgrounds — spends the signal budget without earning return.

rules.name: The Five-Step Depth Rule
rules.body: Zinc provides exactly five depth values: base, surface, elevated, text-muted, text-ghost. Never invent a sixth.

rules.name: The Mono-for-Data Rule
rules.body: Any string that is a URL, slug, identifier, or computed value renders in the monospace stack. Applying Inter to a slug collapses the terminal character.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces at rest are flat. Glass glow appears on the two floating panels only. No other elements receive box-shadow at rest.

dos: Do use monospace for every URL, slug, alias preview, and computed identifier.
Do add active:scale-[.97] or active:scale-95 to every interactive element.
Do keep amber to exactly one or two active elements per screen.
Do use the five-step zinc depth model for all surface layering decisions.
Do write labels in uppercase tracked Inter (font-semibold text-[11px] tracking-widest uppercase).
Do let the dot-grid show through glass surfaces at ≤8% opacity.
donts: Don't add amber to text, borders, icons, or background areas — only CTA button fills and confirmed-copy states.
Don't introduce a second accent color.
Don't use font-mono for anything that isn't a URL, slug, alias, or computed identifier.
Don't stack glass surfaces (blur inside blur).
Don't use pill/circular radius except for status badge chips.
Don't add a light mode, theme toggle, or any prefers-color-scheme: light rule.
Don't place amber glow on more than the result card.
